raise-error.description: The file could not be read as CSV.
raise-error.doc:name: Bad file

set-variable.doc:name: Add REJECTED
set-variable.value: #[vars.outcomes ++ [{ row: vars.row.row, paymentRef: vars.row.paymentRef, invoiceNumber: vars.row.invoiceNumber, result: 'REJECTED', reason: vars.row.reasons joinBy '; ' }]]

set-variable.doc:name: Add outcome
Add FAILED
set-variable.value: #[vars.outcomes ++ [{ row: vars.row.row, paymentRef: vars.row.paymentRef, invoiceNumber: vars.row.invoiceNumber, result: 'FAILED', reason: 'Finance system API unavailable. Safe to reprocess the file.' }]]
#[{ failed: true, detail: error.description default 'Invoice sync failed' }]
set-variable.doc:name: Remember failure

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json fun count(result) = sizeOf(vars.outcomes filter ((o) -> o.result == result)) --- { startedAt: vars.startedAt, finishedAt: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"}, fileName: vars.fileName, rowsRead: sizeOf(vars.outcomes), applied: count("APPLIED"), duplicates: count("DUPLICATE"), rejected: count("REJECTED"), failed: count("FAILED"), rows: vars.outcomes, invoiceSync: vars.invoiceSync }

logger.doc:name: Log file
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'payments file name=' ++ payload.fileName ++ ' rows=' ++ (payload.rowsRead as String) ++ ' applied=' ++ (payload.applied as String) ++ ' duplicates=' ++ (payload.duplicates as String) ++ ' rejected=' ++ (payload.rejected as String) ++ ' failed=' ++ (payload.failed as String)]
